faqs.question: Is the Free plan really free?
faqs.answer: Yes — Free is free forever, no credit card. You can run a ChatGPT visibility check on demand, up to 3 times a month, on 10 tracked prompts. Paid plans automate the tracking daily and add more engines.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Free and Starter?
faqs.answer: Free is a manual ChatGPT spot-check — you run it yourself, up to 3 times a month, on 10 tracked prompts. Starter ($99/mo) automates daily tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews / AI Mode on 20 prompts, and adds Deep Analyses and Content Audits for diagnosis.

faqs.question: How much does SolCrys cost?
faqs.answer: SolCrys starts free, with no credit card. Paid plans are Starter ($99/mo) and Pro ($399/mo), plus a sales-led Custom plan (from $2,000/mo) — you only upgrade when you outgrow the free tier.

faqs.question: What counts as a tracked prompt?
faqs.answer: A tracked prompt is one buyer question in your workspace. SolCrys runs that prompt against the engines included in your plan unless you disable an engine for that prompt.

faqs.question: What is a Deep Analysis?
faqs.answer: A Deep Analysis reviews prompt performance, AI answers, citations, sources, competitor presence, engine differences, and answer accuracy to identify visibility gaps and recommend the next actions.

faqs.question: How is a Content Audit different?
faqs.answer: A Content Audit reviews a specific page or content asset for answer-readiness, crawlability, source fit, credibility, and whether it gives AI engines the facts they need to cite or recommend your brand. On the Custom plan, Content Audits run full-site — every page on your domain, not one URL at a time.

faqs.question: What is Answer Accuracy?
faqs.answer: Answer Accuracy grades each AI answer about your brand pass or fail against your Corporate Context — your source of truth — across the engines you track, and shows exactly what an engine got wrong. Pro includes Answer Accuracy on up to 15 prompts, graded against your auto-generated Corporate Context. Custom grades it on every prompt against a Managed Corporate Context — a deeper, continuously-maintained source of truth we research and verify for you.

faqs.question: Why does the Free plan only include ChatGPT?
faqs.answer: Free focuses on ChatGPT — it's where most teams get their first answer on whether AI discovery surfaces them. Starter then adds Google's AI ecosystem (Gemini, AI Overviews / AI Mode), and Pro adds Perplexity and Claude — Pro tracks any 4 of the 5 engines.

faqs.question: Is Claude included in Pro?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pro and Custom can track Claude (Anthropic) as one of the five answer engines. Pro picks any 4 of the 5 — ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews / AI Mode, Perplexity, and Claude — and many teams swap Claude in for Perplexity; Custom can run all five. Claude is opt-in per workspace, not enabled by default.

faqs.question: Are Amazon Rufus and Walmart Sparky included?
faqs.answer: Not in the default brand tiers. Rufus and Sparky are packaged as a Retail AI Add-on for ecommerce teams because retail assistant access, sampling, and SKU-level validation need a different workflow from standard answer-engine tracking.

faqs.question: Is MCP included?
faqs.answer: MCP support is included on paid workspaces with monthly call limits by plan. MCP is mostly read access: result lookup, summaries, and evidence retrieval. Opt-in write permissions let an assistant do narrow tasks, such as marking an approved Action Hub task as published. It cannot trigger new runs, create audits, publish content to your site, or write to connected systems.

faqs.question: How are agency plans different?
faqs.answer: Agency plans sell client organization capacity, not seats. Each client organization has its own prompt set, reporting context, and diagnosis workflow so agencies can package AEO as a repeatable service.

faqs.question: Do you offer a Custom plan?
faqs.answer: Yes — the Custom plan (from $2,000/mo) is scoped with you: higher caps, every engine, retail, a Managed Corporate Context we research and maintain for you, full-site Content Audits across your entire domain, managed delivery, and custom governance and reporting. We confirm the specifics during evaluation instead of treating them as default self-serve features.
